meta.title: 照片通透是由什么决定的呢？通透只需两点
meta.title_en: What Makes a Photo Clear? Just Two Things
meta.topic: 照片通透 · 去灰与颜色

scenes.context: 通透的本质就两点：一去灰，二颜色干净。
sentences: How do you make a photo look clear and vivid?
Clarity comes down to just two things.
One, remove the haze; two, keep colors clean.
paraphrase: How do you get that crisp, clean look in photos?
Colors should stay pure and untinted.
scenes.speak: How do you make a photo look clear and vivid? Clarity comes down to just two things. One, remove the haze; two, keep colors clean.

scenes.title_en: Remove the Haze with the Histogram
scenes.context: 直方图缺暗部和亮部、信息堆在灰部，压暗增亮即可通透。
sentences: 直方图缺少暗部和亮部。
The histogram lacks shadows and highlights.
The data bunches up in the midtones.
只需要压暗暗部，增亮亮部。
Just deepen the shadows and lift the highlights.
paraphrase: 把「集中在灰部」换个说法
Everything is crammed into the gray middle.
Push the darks down and pull the brights up.
scenes.speak: The histogram lacks shadows and highlights. The data bunches up in the midtones. Just deepen the shadows and lift the highlights. The image becomes clear.

scenes.context: 换场景仍显脏是颜色不纯——在可选颜色中修中性色，水面脏就加青和蓝。
sentences: 用同样的办法，照片看起来还是显脏。
Using the same trick, the photo still looks dirty.
The colors might not be pure enough.
在可选颜色中调中性色。
In selective color, adjust the neutrals.
中性色加青色和邻近色蓝色。
Add cyan to the neutrals, plus the adjacent blue.
paraphrase: The shot still looks muddy. · muddy（浑浊的）
The color isn't clean enough — that's the culprit.
scenes.speak: Using the same trick, the photo still looks dirty. The colors might not be pure enough. In selective color, adjust the neutrals. Add cyan to the neutrals, plus the adjacent blue. The colors turn clean.

practice: Clarity comes down to just two things.
Deepen the shadows and lift the highlights.
在可选颜色中调中性色。
In selective color, adjust the neutrals.
pitfalls: How do you make a photo look clear and vivid?
问句需加助动词 do；make + 宾语 + 补语用 look/be
The data is concentrated in gray.
The data bunches up in the midtones.
bunch up 更口语；midtones 是「中间调」的标准词
Deepen the shadows and lift the highlights.
加 the 且用复数，指画面中的暗部亮部区域
Adjust neutral color in the selected color.
In selective color, adjust the neutrals.
selective color 是 Photoshop 工具名，neutrals 是固定说法
shifts: 照片不通透就加对比度
先看直方图两端信息缺在哪
颜色不纯时还要修中性色
水面脏要选中性色加邻近色
footer_notes: ASR 校正说明：视频原文「临近色」识别为「邻近色」，正文统一。
